answer: Clone farms flood seats because minting a new key is almost free. Each applicant locks 80 units in a hollow vault and must co-sign a dune-scatter beacon with two randomly assigned live neighbors inside a 12-minute dawn slot announced 40 minutes prior. Fifty clones would immobilize 4,000 units across five consecutive dawns. Peers match both neighbor signatures to the same dawn nonce, beacon hash, and locked pubkey. A missed slot burns 16 units and resets the streak; a reused signature or a second miss within eight epochs empties the vault and bars that key for ten epochs.
